dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual linear narrowing from the mid-section toward the visible posterior extremity.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform medium-grey tone across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient boundaries observed between the high-reflectance linear marks and the grey baseline epidermis.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast, light-colored parallel rake marks on the posterior-lateral dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, light-toned parallel rake marks arranged in a curved pattern on the posterior dorsal region.
